cost.binNote: Wiki cost decreases per champion level (40 down to 23) via the pp formula; the sheet shows a flat cost of 40 with no level scaling, so the level curve is not reflected in the bin's `cost` field.

values.binNote: RecastShield also adds the rank-based ShieldBase term ([45..145]) shown separately in the wiki quote as '(+ {{ap|45 to 145 6}})'; that additive rank component is not represented in this value's level-based base list because the schema base list is single-dimensional (by level only).
RecastHeal = RecastShield * PercentOfShieldHealAmount(0.5); the rank-based additive part ('+ {{ap|45/2 to 145/2 6}}') is not captured in this value's level-based base list for the same reason as w_3.
The bin has no separate per-tick row; this is Total Healing (RecastHeal) divided by the number of ticks (ShieldDuration/tick-rate = 4/0.25 = 16), a wiki-only derived construct.

values.meaning: heal on-hit per empowered attack (Mantle Stance)
heal on-hit per empowered attack (Awaken, doubled)
values.quote: heal him for {{as|{{fd|{{ap|{{#var:wo_h}}*2}}}}% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:wo_ap}}*2}}% AP)}}

values.binNote: No bin row stores the tick interval; the sheet's ShieldDuration=4 is the only related field and the tick count (4/0.25=16) is only derivable from the wiki's w_st variable, which has no bin counterpart.
Bin stores the penalty as a 0.4 reduction factor (implying 60% effectiveness, i.e. 1-0.4); wiki states the resulting 60% directly, both agree once interpreted correctly.

mechanics.claim: Active empowers Udyr's next two basic attacks on-hit with life steal and a flat heal, and grants Udyr a shield.
mechanics.quote: empowering his next two basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} to gain {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|heal}} him

mechanics.claim: Recasting (Awaken) increases the shield's strength, stacking with the remaining shield from the first cast, adds a heal-over-time, and doubles the life steal and heal of the empowered attacks.
mechanics.quote: increases the {{tip|shield|shield's}} strength, stacking with the remaining shield from the first cast, and {{tip|heals}} every {{fd|{{#var:w_st}}}} seconds over the next {{#var:w_sd}} seconds, as well as causes the empowered attacks to instead gain doubled {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}

mechanics.claim: Healing on-hit is reduced against minions.
The empowered attacks apply on-hit/spell effects to the target.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks apply {{tip|spell effects}} to the target.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attacks are not consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.

mechanics.claim: The increased life steal buff is a flat buff that expires after two valid attacks land, not a per-attack modifier, so effects like Ravenous Hydra heal at the increased rate while active.
mechanics.quote: The increased life steal is a buff that expires after two valid attacks have been completed, as opposed to an on-attack modifier for your next two attacks. This means that while the buff is active, {{ii|Ravenous Hydra}} will heal at the increased life steal value.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, but recasting refreshes the ability's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast, but recasting refreshes the cooldown
